senses.gloss: m. pl. name of a Persian and of a Babylonian festive season, (v. preced. a. next w.).
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 11b:7">Ab. Zar. 11ᵇ</cite> (Ms. M. <he>מוהרסנקי</he> for the Persian season; ed. Ven. a. oth. <he>מהרנקי</he>); Y. ib. I, 39ᶜ <cite ref="M03065"><he>מתירקנה</he></cite>, a Median season (prob. a corruption of our w.). [V. Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. p. 305<sup>2</sup>.]
